description: Microsoft Word is open with 'fms_requirements_raw.docx', a Software Requirements Specification for the Collins Aerospace FMS-4000 Flight Management System. The document is unformatted plain text. You are a Systems Engineer at Collins Aerospace responsible for formatting this SRS to IEEE 29148-2018 standards before the Critical Design Review (CDR). Complete ALL of the following: (1) Apply 'Heading 1' style to the 8 numbered top-level sections: '1. INTRODUCTION', '2. OVERALL DESCRIPTION', '3. NAVIGATION MANAGEMENT REQUIREMENTS', '4. PERFORMANCE COMPUTATION REQUIREMENTS', '5. ROUTE MANAGEMENT REQUIREMENTS', '6. DISPLAY MANAGEMENT REQUIREMENTS', '7. SAFETY AND RELIABILITY REQUIREMENTS', '8. INTERFACE REQUIREMENTS'; (2) Apply 'Heading 2' style to all numbered sub-sections (e.g., '1.1 Purpose', '1.2 Scope', '2.1 Product Perspective', '3.1 Position Determination Requirements', '4.1 Takeoff Performance', '5.1 Flight Plan Entry and Modification', '6.1 CDU/MCDU Display Interface', '7.1 Software Safety Requirements', '8.1 External Interface Summary', and all others); (3) Insert a Table of Contents at the beginning of the document before the title; (4) Format the 18 Requirements Traceability Matrix entries (RTM-001 through RTM-018) at the end of the document into a formatted table with columns for Req ID, Req Title, Parent Req, Regulatory Source, Verification Method, and Verification Procedure — the table must have at least 10 data rows; (5) Add both a header and a footer: the header must contain 'Collins Aerospace | FMS-4000 SRS | PROPRIETARY' and the footer must contain 'Document No: CA-FMS4-SRS-001 | Revision C'; (6) Save the file as 'fms_srs_final.docx' in the Desktop\WordTasks folder.
